# Files exempt from the attribution check, one repo-relative path per line.
#
# Deliberately empty, and it should stay that way.
#
# An entry here exempts the WHOLE file from EVERY needle, permanently — the
# check skips the path before reading a byte of it. On a prose document that
# keeps being edited, that means a pasted transcript or an embedded image
# would go unseen forever. The cost is not proportional to the problem it
# solves.
#
# Policy this file exists to record: a competitor's product name is not a
# finding. Naming Microsoft Copilot in the pricing benchmark, or as the
# incumbent a wave replaces, is legitimate research, and the check does not
# look for those names at all — so those documents need no exemption. What is
# forbidden is attribution of the assistant used to produce the work, and the
# metadata containers that carry it.
#
# Before adding a path, strip the file instead. If a file genuinely must carry
# a needle, prefer narrowing the check to that path and that needle over
# exempting the whole file.
